01 / ABOUT

Behind the scenes, in the room, or on the mic.

My work sits where people, projects and gaming meet. I’ve worked with teams and partners across Southeast Asia, supported competitive gaming programs, managed stakeholder relationships, helped move projects from idea to execution, and spent years telling esports stories live on broadcast.

The common thread is simple: clear communication, strong relationships and making sure the work actually moves.
